baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative binds bestowed benefits to a sovereign who owns and progressively tends them, then makes the two addressees answer for declaring that gift-relation false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors are the literal branch image and supply the questioned objects.
Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the source and standing of the address.
Repair and stagewise nurture make the favors administered goods rather than detached possessions.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the addressees' answer-act.

changed_reading.before: A generic accusation that two hearers are lying.
changed_reading.after: A dual-address demand to identify which bestowed and administered benefits they can treat as false.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots can cohere juridically: oath, a covenant held by the Lord, a claim that follows its holder, and a charge whose truth is proved by being carried through.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies the pledged side of the relation.
A binding pact gathered under protection makes lordship covenantal in this model.
A liability or right following its holder supplies the continuing claim generated by the bond.
A charge proving true or false through performance turns denial into default, not speech alone.

changed_reading.after: The addressees are challenged over which pledged claims they will default on by failing to carry the relation through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءَالَاءِ ... تُكَذِّبَانِ as a second-person turn
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant ت ل و mapping lets the focus resonate with sequence and one voice following another; stagewise nurture and performed truth then make the question an answer-turn after prior disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies a turn positioned after something already given.
A voice following a voice supplies the antiphonal shape of the addressees' response.
Stagewise completion gives the imagined sequence an administering source.
Fulfilling or failing a charge makes the answering voice prove its truth in performance.

changed_reading.before: An isolated rhetorical question requiring no audible turn.
changed_reading.after: A response slot following prior disclosure, where the next voice confirms or fails what it has received.

baseline_models.mechanism: Two coexisting ء ل و branches place ability beside falling short; under lordly authority, the ك ذ ب performance branch reads denial as the gap between granted capacity and a charge not made true.

activation_trace.role: Capacity or ability supplies what the addressees are enabled to do.
Falling short or withholding effort supplies the failure side of the capacity gap.
Authority places both capacity and obligation within a governed relation.
A charge that fails in execution converts shortfall into practical falsification.

changed_reading.after: Within which Lord-given capacities do you withhold effort and let the entrusted charge fail?

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and البيان make benefaction legible: what is given is also disclosed, marked, and expressible, so denial becomes a counter-reading of accessible evidence.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors keep the epistemic model anchored to the focus object.
Declaring something false supplies the counter-reading performed by denial.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower makes teaching an activation of recognition.
Meaning revealed by speech or sign makes the favor readable and answerable.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 moves through mercy, teaching, creating the human, and teaching articulation before the refrain appears.
The focus interrogative asks the two addressees to discriminate rather than merely hear a declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching and branch images of disclosure and signification; I infer that intelligibility is itself part of the favor and that denial is epistemic refusal. A live alternative is that these are simply separate favors in a list.

changed_reading.before: The favors are benefits that may be verbally rejected.
changed_reading.after: The favors are made knowable signs, and denial is a refusal to read what has been disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scale sequence makes truth operational: justice aligns two sides, while diminishing measure is a visible shortfall. The focus denial therefore includes making the gift-order false in exchange and conduct.

activation_trace.role: Falling short supplies the deficit enacted in an unjust measure.
A charge proving false by failed execution turns denial into conduct.
The scale of justice supplies the public instrument by which performance is tested.
Equity and fairness supply the norm that balanced performance must realize.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete form of practical denial.

structural_cues: 55:7 places the scale after the raised sky, and 55:8-9 turn that order into prohibitions and commands.
The same dual audience later receives the refrain, linking cosmic calibration to accountable action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scale, equity, short-measure, and a focus branch where a charge fails in execution; I infer that distorting measure falsifies the acknowledged order. The alternative is that ethical measurement and verbal denial remain parallel themes.

changed_reading.before: Denial is chiefly an assertion about the favors.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be enacted by short measure: conduct makes the acknowledged order fail in practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Emergence and setting, two waters meeting, a relation between them, and refusal to overrun the limit turn favor from an inventory of objects into an architecture that keeps differences connected without collapse.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the governing source of the paired order.
Light rising from the east supplies one pole of the immediate pair.
Sunset supplies the answering pole and completes the horizon cycle.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies contact without identity.
A connection standing between endpoints makes the barrier relational rather than merely divisive.
Transgressing a limit by aggression supplies the failure that the boundary prevents.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart extends paired coherence into provision.

structural_cues: The focus has dual possessive and verbal endings immediately after the two easts and two wests and before the two seas.
Dual gardens, springs, and fruit-pairs continue the paired grammar later in the packet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring duals, meeting, relation, and non-transgression; I infer that maintained difference-in-relation is itself an ālāʾ. A live alternative is that the dual phenomena are separate examples addressed to two audiences.

changed_reading.before: Which individual benefits will the two addressees deny?
changed_reading.after: Which paired limits and relations that let unlike sides coexist will the two addressees collapse or disown?

context_deltas.mechanism: Thirty neighboring recurrences activate the split-root images of following sequence and voice-after-voice: the refrain repeatedly opens an answer slot, so even silence or denial becomes the second voice.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies the focus's latent call-and-response form.
The earlier identical occurrence makes the same voice-following image recur before the focus.
Following in sequence makes the later identical occurrence the next checkpoint after another scene.
Declaring false names the negative answer that can occupy the opened response slot.

structural_cues: The exact four-word refrain occurs thirty-one times including the focus, with intervening scenes repeatedly resetting its force.
Dual second-person morphology keeps the expected answer socially distributed between two addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence and branch images of sequence and answering voice; I infer an antiphonal response-space rather than an inert repeated slogan. The materially live alternative is emphatic rhetorical repetition with no implied audible reply.

changed_reading.before: A repeated accusation whose recurrence only intensifies emphasis.
changed_reading.after: A recurring answer-turn in which each new disclosure waits for the two addressees' confirming or denying voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between universal passing and the remaining face activates ك ذ ب as disappointed duration and ت ل و as remainder: denial can be the false premise that a genuine favor must itself be permanent.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails an expectation of duration supplies the temporal form of apparent falsification.
A remainder following what preceded supplies what persists after passing goods.
Cessation and departure after a period of being supplies the explicit finite side.
Continuance supplies the explicit counterpoint to finite benefit.
The face standing for the self locates permanence in the giver rather than every gift.

structural_cues: 55:26 says all upon the earth passes; 55:27 answers with what remains; 55:28 then repeats the challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failure-of-duration, remainder, passing, and continuance; I infer that demanding permanence from each favor is one way of miscalling it false. The alternative is that the duration idiom is only a distant lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: A favor is denied by saying it was never real.
changed_reading.after: A favor may be denied by treating its finitude as failed promise, while the passage relocates permanence in the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord's cloud and collected-water branches join seas, flowing provision, springs, gushing water, and settled blessing into a flow-storage system. Favors become maintained circulation rather than isolated commodities.

activation_trace.role: A low persistent cloud supplies the Lord-root's water-nurturing image.
Abundant collected water supplies storage within the same lordly root.
Wide abundant water supplies the large reservoir in the system.
Continuing provision turns flow into sustained giving rather than mere motion.
A spring of running water supplies a localized source feeding the circulation.
Water welling abundantly supplies pressure and renewal in the flow.
Stable growing good supplies the system's durable yield without making every component permanent.

structural_cues: The packet moves from seas and their products to flowing garden springs, then gushing springs, fruits, and final blessing.
Boundaries in 55:20 keep circulation from becoming undifferentiated mixing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water reservoirs, flows, sources, pressure, and stable growth; I infer an integrated provisioning ecology administered under ر ب ب. A live alternative is that these remain independent abundance images.

changed_reading.before: Favors are countable goods delivered to recipients.
changed_reading.after: Favors include the maintained circulation, storage, boundaries, and renewal by which goods can keep arriving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to cross the cosmic margins activates the focus's ability/shortfall tension: passage is imaginable, but effective only through governing authority and compelling proof, so capacity is granted and bounded rather than self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Ability supplies the positive side of the focus's latent capacity question.
Falling short supplies the limit exposed when passage cannot be completed.
Authority keeps capacity dependent on the Lord named in the focus.
Capability and power to act repeat the focus's latent ability branch explicitly.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the action whose boundary tests capacity.
Compelling proof supplies the condition under which passage has force.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses both communities, conditionally invites passage beyond the margins, repeats the passage verb, and then restricts it.
The same dual audience receives the refrain immediately afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ability, failed or successful passage, and compelling authority; I infer that the focus audits whether recipients mistake conferred capacity for autonomy. The alternative is a discrete escape challenge unrelated to the favors wording.

changed_reading.before: Capacity is one more benefit that can be acknowledged or denied.
changed_reading.after: The challenge exposes capacity itself as a bounded favor whose limit cannot be falsified by attempted escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by marks, criminal acquisition, and the later explicit object of denial make the focus question forensic: denial is not hidden opinion but an attributable stance that becomes legible on the denier.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood anchors the forensic model in the focus verb.
Recognition and discrimination from a trace or sign make identity evidential.
Offense and culpability supply the accountable status recognized by the marks.
A visible mark indicating one's state supplies the outward evidence of the stance.
The later explicit act of declaring the named reality false gives the refrain's denial a concrete referent.

structural_cues: 55:39 withholds questioning, 55:41 identifies offenders by marks, and 55:43 names what they had denied.
Refrains at 55:40, 55:42, and 55:45 surround that evidentiary disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible identification, culpability, and a later explicit denial; I infer that 55:18 already functions as a charge whose answer will become manifest. The alternative is that the later judgment scene only repeats the same vocabulary without revising the earlier question.

changed_reading.before: The question asks for a private verbal position toward benefits.
changed_reading.after: The question records an attributable denial that later evidence can identify and attach to its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: A gift that seeks a fitting response, a covenantal claim, and action answered by its counterpart turn the refrain into reciprocity: received good solicits an answering good, while denial is a mismatched return.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a pledged answer within the focus root.
A covenant or protection pact supplies the durable relation in which response matters.
A gift that seeks recompense supplies the expectation of a fitting return.
An answer of satisfaction supplies the non-denying response the gift can receive.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies explicit reciprocal structure.
Doing what is good supplies both sides of the matching return.

structural_cues: 55:60 poses good's recompense as good and 55:61 immediately restores the refrain.
The uncitable ج ل ل occurrences at 55:27 and 55:78 structurally pair with ك ر م; no branch identity is assigned to ج ل ل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, covenant, recompense, and matched good; I infer a fitting answer rather than a commercial purchase of favor. A live alternative is radically asymmetrical gift for which gratitude is appropriate but not a compensating debt.

changed_reading.before: Denial is failure to acknowledge what was received.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a mismatched return, while truthful acknowledgment answers received good with fitting good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It is surprising because an idiom about a running animal stopping to look behind is far from the focus verb's ordinary sense. It remains anchored in the focus ك ذ ب branch and gains visible support from sequential refrains and running flow. Render only as a discourse-motion analogy: the refrain can act like a retrospective checkpoint, not as a translation of تُكَذِّبَانِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ at the end of a recurring clause

activation_trace.role: Running a stage and then stopping to look behind supplies the retrospective-pause image.
Following in sequence places another refrain after the discourse resumes.
Running or flowing motion supplies the continuing movement punctuated by review.

changed_reading.before: The refrain only halts the description to repeat an accusation.
changed_reading.after: The refrain periodically stops a running sequence and makes the hearers look back over the stage just traversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cloth, furnishings, linings, and pure-lie branches cross from material description into epistemology. It remains anchored by the focus branch of deceptive variegated cloth and by actual furnishing and lining roots later in the packet. Render as a qualified surface-versus-interior analogy, never as a claim that the focus lexically means textile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ through the deceptive-cloth branch of ك ذ ب

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth whose appearance deceives supplies the focus's material image of false surface.
A furnishing root branch that itself means falsehood makes a spread surface double as a truth problem.
A hidden interior supplies the concealed underside against which the visible face is tested.
Precious patterned carpets supply the actual ornate surface in the later scene.
The same carpet root's pure-lie branch keeps ornament and falsity in unresolved proximity.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a proposition spoken against visible favors.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be imagined as laying down a persuasive surface that misreports its lining, so the refrain audits appearance against interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mariners' chief is a rare ر ب ب branch and does not replace the ordinary Lord reading. It remains anchored in رَبِّكُمَا and is locally activated by horizons, seas, flow, and raised ships around the focus. Render as a navigational resonance under lordship, not as lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبِّكُمَا between paired horizons and the sea sequence

activation_trace.role: A mariners' chief supplies a rare navigational image for the Lord named in the focus.
A charge proved by carrying it through makes the voyage an image of performed trust.
Light rising at the eastern horizon supplies one navigational bearing immediately before the focus.
Sunset supplies the opposite bearing and completes the horizon frame.
Seafaring supplies the domain in which a mariners' chief has functional force.
Rising and elevation supply the raised-ship image that follows the sea passage.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is named abstractly as owner of the favors.
changed_reading.after: At this horizon-to-sea hinge, lordship also resonates as guidance under a chief whose bearings and limits let the voyage be carried through.

strongest_changes: The scale sequence changed denial from speech into measurable failure of just performance.
Repeated ء ل و occurrences activated the split ت ل و images of sequence and answering voice, making the refrain a recurring response slot.
Paired horizons and bounded meeting waters changed favors from isolated objects into maintained relations between unlike sides.
Passing and remaining exposed false duration-expectation as another mode of denial.
Visible marks and the later explicit object of denial made the question forensic, while reciprocal good made its truthful answer performative.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several mechanisms at once: gift-recognition, covenantal performance, antiphonal response, bounded capacity, temporal testing, and circulating provision. Form-distant branches also opened contained but live readings of the refrain as a stop-and-review cadence, a textile surface/interior audit, and a navigational hinge.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و activations depend on a non-dominant split mapping and should remain resonances rather than lexical replacements for ءَالَاءِ.
The duration, hydrological, and reciprocity arrows are reader-supplied system models; the packet also permits the cited scenes to remain independent examples.
Dual morphology may coordinate two audiences without making every paired phenomenon a model of their relation.
The textile and mariner outliers are branch-backed material analogies but remain too form-distant for unqualified commentary.
